BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to eliminating gangrelated activities on or nearschool grounds; adding new sections to chapter 9A.46 RCW; andprescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9A.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the children of this state have theright to go to and from school in a safe and secure manner withoutbeing threatened, intimidated, harassed, confronted, or solicited bygang members and gang activities. Gangassociated violence and sale,use, and possession of illegal drugs and weapons are not appropriate orconducive to a safe learning environment and must be eliminated ifstudent security is to be promoted on and near school grounds andfacilities. In addition to physical safety zones, schools should alsobe gangfree zones that expressly prohibit gang activities on or nearschool property.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9A.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The definitions in this section apply throughout this section andsections 1, 3, and 4 of this act unless the context clearly requiresotherwise. (1) "Gang" means a group that: (a) Consists of three or morepersons; (b) has identifiable leadership or an identifiable name, sign,or symbol; and (c) on an ongoing basis, regularly conspires and acts inconcert mainly for criminal purposes. (2) "Gangrelated activity" means any activity that occurs by orwithin a gang or advances a gang purpose, including threatening,intimidating, harassing, confronting, or soliciting a person whoattends or is registered in a public or alternative school with or bymeans of a criminal act or to participate or engage in a criminal act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9A.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of criminal gang school activity if theperson is a gang member and engages in a gangrelated activity in orupon the premises or grounds of a public or alternative school, orwithin five hundred feet of the premises of a public or alternativeschool. (2) Criminal gang school activity is a class C felony. (3) The perimeter of the premises or grounds of any school coveredby this section shall be posted at reasonable intervals to alert thepublic as to the existence of this section prohibiting criminal gangschool activity on or within five hundred feet of the premises andgrounds.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9A.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of criminal gang school trespass if theperson is a gang member and knowingly enters or remains unlawfully inor upon the premises or grounds of a public or alternative school. (2) Criminal gang school trespass is a gross misdemeanor. (3) The perimeter of the premises or grounds of any school coveredby this section shall be posted at reasonable intervals to alert thepublic as to the existence of this section prohibiting criminal gang HB 2543 p. 2 school trespass on the premises and grounds.
